verdict.rationale: Polar documents a remote MCP server that lets agents "take actions across your products", plus official typed SDKs and versioned OpenAPI specs. That makes agent-driven provisioning plausible. However, Checkout Links are described as "configure once in the dashboard", and the API-driven path documented is the Checkout Session API rather than reusable payment-link creation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of product and price creation endpoints, API or MCP creation of shareable checkout links, and any hands-on evidence of an agent completing product, price and link provisioning in one session.
